title: High Potential
creator: Drew Goddard
synopsis: Morgan, a single mother with a remarkable ability to spot patterns, is recruited to help the Los Angeles police solve difficult cases. Her unconventional methods challenge her rule-following detective partner.

title: Ghoul
creator: Patrick Graham
synopsis: In a dystopian India, a newly recruited interrogator arrives at a secret military detention center, where a mysterious prisoner unleashes a terrifying supernatural threat.

title: Community
creator: Dan Harmon
synopsis: A disbarred lawyer enrolls at Greendale Community College and forms a study group with an eccentric mix of students, whose friendships turn ordinary campus life into absurd adventures.

title: Love, Death & Robots
creator: Tim Miller
synopsis: An adult animated anthology explores science fiction, horror, fantasy and dark humor through standalone stories told in a wide range of visual styles.

title: Good Omens
creator: Neil Gaiman
synopsis: An angel and a demon who have grown fond of life on Earth form an unlikely alliance to prevent an approaching apocalypse and challenge the plans of Heaven and Hell.

title: Friends
creator: David Crane, Marta Kauffman
synopsis: Six friends navigate careers, romance, family and adulthood while sharing everyday ups and downs in New York City.

title: The Bear
creator: Christopher Storer
synopsis: A gifted fine-dining chef returns to Chicago to run his late brother's sandwich shop, where a struggling staff, family tensions and restaurant ambitions test his resolve.

title: The Punisher
creator: Steve Lightfoot
synopsis: Frank Castle, a former Marine haunted by his family's murder, pursues violent justice and uncovers conspiracies tied to his military past.

title: White Collar
creator: Jeff Eastin
synopsis: Charming con artist Neal Caffrey makes a deal to assist FBI agent Peter Burke, using his expertise in forgery, theft and deception to catch sophisticated criminals.

title: Scorpion
creator: Nick Santora
synopsis: An eccentric team of geniuses works with Homeland Security to solve high-stakes technical and national-security crises while struggling with everyday social challenges.

title: The Witcher
creator: Lauren Schmidt Hissrich
synopsis: Geralt of Rivia, a solitary monster hunter, finds his fate intertwined with a powerful sorceress and a princess whose abilities could reshape a war-torn world.

title: Castle
creator: Andrew W. Marlowe
synopsis: A best-selling mystery novelist teams up with NYPD detective Kate Beckett, drawing on his imagination to help solve murders while developing a complicated partnership.

title: Stranger Things
creator: Matt Duffer, Ross Duffer
synopsis: After a boy vanishes in a small Indiana town, his friends uncover secret experiments, a mysterious girl and a dangerous alternate dimension.

title: Moon Knight
creator: Jeremy Slater
synopsis: A mild-mannered museum worker experiences blackouts and discovers he shares a body with a mercenary linked to an Egyptian god, pulling him into a supernatural mystery.

title: Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan
creator: Carlton Cuse, Graham Roland
synopsis: CIA analyst Jack Ryan is pulled out of his desk job and into dangerous field operations as he tracks international plots threatening global security.

title: Altered Carbon
creator: Laeta Kalogridis
synopsis: In a future where human consciousness can be transferred between bodies, a former soldier is revived to investigate a wealthy man's apparent murder.

title: Chernobyl
creator: Craig Mazin
synopsis: This historical miniseries dramatizes the 1986 nuclear disaster in Soviet Ukraine and the efforts of scientists, workers and officials to contain its consequences.

title: The Boys
creator: Eric Kripke
synopsis: In a world where superheroes are powerful celebrities shielded by a corporation, a rogue group seeks to expose and confront their corruption and abuse.

title: The Mentalist
creator: Bruno Heller
synopsis: Patrick Jane, a brilliant observer and former fake psychic, works with California investigators to solve crimes while pursuing the serial killer who destroyed his family.

title: Sherlock
creator: Mark Gatiss, Steven Moffat
synopsis: A modern-day Sherlock Holmes and Dr. John Watson investigate extraordinary crimes across London, relying on deduction, observation and an uneasy friendship.

title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
creator: Dan Goor, Michael Schur
synopsis: Talented but immature detective Jake Peralta and his colleagues juggle crimes, office rivalries and friendships at a Brooklyn police precinct.

title: Grimm
creator: Stephen Carpenter, David Greenwalt, Jim Kouf
synopsis: Portland homicide detective Nick Burkhardt learns he is a Grimm, a guardian able to see the mythical creatures hiding among humans, complicating his police work.

title: The Last of Us
creator: Craig Mazin, Neil Druckmann
synopsis: Decades after a fungal infection devastates civilization, a hardened survivor is tasked with escorting a teenage girl across a dangerous and divided America.

title: Modern Family
creator: Christopher Lloyd, Steven Levitan
synopsis: Three interconnected households tackle parenting, marriage and generational differences in this mockumentary about an extended family.

title: Black Mirror
creator: Charlie Brooker
synopsis: A speculative anthology tells unsettling standalone stories about technology, society and the unexpected consequences of modern innovations.

title: Breaking Bad
creator: Vince Gilligan
synopsis: After a cancer diagnosis, chemistry teacher Walter White begins manufacturing methamphetamine with a former student, setting off an escalating spiral of crime and moral compromise.

title: House M.D.
creator: David Shore
synopsis: Brilliant but abrasive diagnostician Dr. Gregory House leads a medical team that tackles baffling illnesses while clashing with patients, colleagues and authority.

title: Reacher
creator: Nick Santora
synopsis: Former military police investigator Jack Reacher travels with few possessions, repeatedly becoming entangled in conspiracies and using sharp deduction and combat skills to expose them.

title: The Queen's Gambit
creator: Scott Frank, Allan Scott
synopsis: Orphaned chess prodigy Beth Harmon rises through the competitive chess world during the Cold War while grappling with addiction, loneliness and ambition.

title: Loki
creator: Michael Waldron
synopsis: After escaping with the Tesseract, Loki is apprehended by an organization that oversees the timeline and becomes embroiled in conflicts involving identity, fate and the multiverse.

title: Castlevania
creator: Warren Ellis
synopsis: A monster hunter, a sorceress and Dracula's son join forces to protect humanity from the vampire lord's campaign of vengeance in a dark fantasy world.

title: Person of Interest
creator: Jonathan Nolan
synopsis: A reclusive billionaire and an ex-CIA operative use a predictive surveillance system to identify people connected to imminent violent crimes and intervene before it is too late.

title: The Umbrella Academy
creator: Steve Blackman
synopsis: Estranged siblings with unusual powers reunite after their adoptive father's death and confront family secrets, dangerous enemies and threats to the world.

title: A Series of Unfortunate Events
creator: Mark Hudis, Barry Sonnenfeld
synopsis: The Baudelaire orphans move between guardians while outwitting the scheming Count Olaf, who wants their inheritance, and uncovering clues about their parents' past.

title: The Night Agent
creator: Shawn Ryan
synopsis: A low-level FBI agent assigned to an emergency phone line is pulled into a dangerous conspiracy that reaches into the highest levels of the US government.

title: Money Heist
creator: Álex Pina
synopsis: A criminal mastermind known as the Professor recruits a team of specialists to carry out intricate heists while authorities race to stop them.

title: The Blacklist
creator: Jon Bokenkamp
synopsis: A notorious criminal unexpectedly surrenders to the FBI and offers to help capture dangerous fugitives, but insists on working with rookie profiler Elizabeth Keen.

title: The Big Bang Theory
creator: Chuck Lorre, Bill Prady
synopsis: A group of socially awkward physicists and their friends balance careers, relationships and pop-culture obsessions as their lives evolve.

title: How I Met Your Mother
creator: Carter Bays, Craig Thomas
synopsis: Ted Mosby recounts to his children the winding story of how he met their mother, revisiting the friendships, romances and misadventures of his twenties and thirties.

title: The Terminal List
creator: David DiGilio
synopsis: After a disastrous covert mission, Navy SEAL James Reece suspects a cover-up and sets out to uncover the truth as powerful enemies close in.

title: Rick and Morty
creator: Dan Harmon, Justin Roiland
synopsis: An eccentric scientist drags his anxious grandson on chaotic journeys across planets, dimensions and alternate realities, disrupting the lives of their family.

title: Supernatural
creator: Eric Kripke
synopsis: Brothers Sam and Dean Winchester travel across the United States hunting monsters, demons and other supernatural threats while confronting dark family secrets.
